_shapes: Captured from Cursor 3.32.10, 2026-11-27, real preToolUse hook. Paths and text are anonymised; the KEY SHAPES are verbatim, which is the whole point of this file (B-4 in TASK-085).
Shell carries a nested tool_input.cwd and a top-level cwd of '' (empty string, not absent). workspace_roots is the only reliable project signal for Shell.
No cwd key at all for Grep; only workspace_roots. A gate that reads cwd alone gets None here.
MCP tools arrive as 'MCP:<server>' — NOT 'CallDynamicTool' and NOT 'mcp__server__tool'. The arguments are the tool's own, with no wrapper field naming the tool.
Write carries the absolute path in tool_input.file_path and the new contents in tool_input.content.
ReadLints is a read-only tool the gate cannot classify; it carries only a path, and refusing it would block lint feedback during a run.
CallDynamicTool and GetDynamicTools were invoked in the same session and NEVER reached the hook: only the nested MCP:<server> call did. Recorded here so a future reader does not add them by guessing.
